title: Enzikiriza Enkweke Munda Mu Bbugwe w'Olubiri
intro: Wakati mu kkooti ey’abatyobooli ejjudde enkwe n’amalala, emmeeme eyokka ekwata ekyama eky’akabi. Nga yeetooloddwa amaanyi n’okutiisatiisa okufa, omuddu wa Allah ono atunuulira omubaka ng’ayimiridde yekka ng’alwanyisa obwakabaka. Okusirika bwe kufuuka okwenyigira mu kibiina, okusalawo okw’obuvumu kulina okukolebwa okwogera amazima mu kabi ak’amaanyi ak’obuntu.
clues: Nabeera mu bantu ab’amaanyi era ab’amalala abaagaana obubonero bwa Allah.
Nakweka okukkiriza kwange okumala ekiseera ng’abo abaali banneetoolodde bakola olukwe ku mubaka.
Nayogera mu lwatu, ngamba nti: Otta omuntu ssekinnoomu kubanga bagamba nti, Mukama wange ye Allah, so nga n’obukakafu obw’olwatu buzze?
Nalabula abantu bange ku nkomerero y’amawanga agaasooka ne ku Lunaku lw’Okuyitibwa (Mutual Calling).
Nabagamba nti omufuzi gwe naweereza alaga endowooza enfunda yokka, naye ate Akhira y’amaka amatuufu.
Nagamba nti: Abange mmwe abantu bange, mungoberere nange ndibalung’amya mu kkubo ettuufu, era Allah n’antaasa mu bubi bw’olukwe lwabwe.
